question:
The value of 

 25 ÷10-({7over4}times{1over3}) of {6over5}+{14over3}times{9over10}+({1over5}div{1over25}) is:
solution:
**Given:**

 25 ÷10-({7over4}times{1over3}) of {6over5}+{14over3}times{9over10}+({1over5}div{1over25})

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/694d0d67bc14effd3a3679b70b4d77edef851107a6a53b64ea488e47e4c2bef5.png] 

**Calculation:**

 25 ÷10-({7over4}times{1over3}) of {6over5}+{14over3}times{9over10}+({1over5}div{1over25})

⇒ 25 ÷10-({7over12}) of {6over5}+{14over3}times{9over10}+({1over5}times{25over1})

⇒ 25 ÷10-{7over12} of {6over5}+{14over3}times{9over10}+5

⇒ 25 ÷10-{7over10}+{14over3}times{9over10}+5

⇒ {5over2}-{7over10}+{14over3}times{9over10}+5

⇒ {5over2}-{7over10}+{14over3}times{9over10}+5

⇒ {25 - 7+42+50over10}

⇒ {110over10}

⇒ 11

**∴ Required value is 11.**
